lines: Oh, fuck! My shoelace just got eaten by an escalator!
Look at an escalator. See those little brushes on the sides?
Those are side brushes. Everybody walks past them. Nobody thinks about them.
Think about it. Thousands of people step on one of these every single day.
And today... I'm deleting them! Every single brush!
Now a shoe slides right into the gap. Crunch! Holy fuck, that's an expensive sneaker.
The shoe gets pulled down, and the steps keep moving. Not good at all.
The brushes keep feet, shoelaces and clothes away from the gap between the steps and the side wall.
And small kids are the ones who get closest to that gap.
That gap is tiny, but toes and laces fit right in.
They don't stop the escalator, though. That's the emergency stop button's job.
If something gets caught, don't yank it. Hit the red stop button, and get help.
So you're not cleaning your shoes on them, buddy. Those brushes are not a shoe shine.
Those brushes are for keeping stuff out. Not for dusting your socks.
So next time you step on an escalator, look down. Your shoelace is in danger.
Seriously, look down right now. Your shoes are closer to that gap than you think.
So... what should I delete next?
